title: Weighted cut-off gradient bound r∫|u||Dφ| ≤ R|D|u||(U) + n∫_U|u| (Simon 2.8 (5), C4)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open, ξ ∈ ℝⁿ, R > 0 with U ⊆ closedBall(ξ, R), r ∈ ℝ, u ∈ L¹(ℝⁿ), and φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ Lipschitz with 0 ≤ φ ≤ 1, compact support, tsupport φ ⊆ U and r‖Dφ(x)‖ ≤ −Dφ(x)[x − ξ] for Lebesgue-a.e. x (Dφ = fderiv ℝ φ). Then in [0, ∞]: ofReal(r)·∫⁻ ‖u‖ₑ‖Dφ‖ₑ ≤ ofReal(R)·|D|u||(U) + n·∫⁻_U ‖u‖ₑ, where |D|u||(U) := bvVariationOn (x ↦ |u(x)|) U.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (ξ : Rn n) (R r : ℝ) (u φ : Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < R → U ⊆ closedBall ξ R → Integrable u volume → (∃ K, LipschitzWith K φ) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → (∀ᵐ x ∂volume, r * ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ ≤ -fderiv ℝ φ x (x - ξ)) → ENNReal.ofReal r * ∫⁻ x, ‖u x‖ₑ * ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R * Chapter02.bvVariationOn (fun x ↦ |u x|) U + (n : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ x in U, ‖u x‖ₑ
